image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a wood rabbit (cottontail) situated in natural vegetation. The rabbit is facing slightly right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has brown and grey fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears. A blade of grass obscures the lower part of the mouth/nose area.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed a wood rabbit/cottontail and not a hare or other lagomorph.
To verify the structural integrity of the visible head, neck, and shoulder connection, ensuring no fusion artifacts.
To analyze the fine-grained details of the fur for AI-generation artifacts like smearing or repetitive patterns.
To check for edge bleeding between the ear/fur and the background vegetation.

focus_areas: Edge definition between ears and background
Structural connection of head to body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the fur texture around the ears and cheeks. AI models often struggle with the transition from fine whiskers to dense fur. Verify if the eye looks 'glassy' or plastic-like, which is a common artifact. Check the blade of grass in front of the mouth for logical depth ordering (does it look like it's actually in front?).
